ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your career and your image. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your career. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between romance and intimacy. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between family and relationships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and routine. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between money and romance. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up home and family.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your image and family. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1802429070000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between Venus and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and money. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.
